description: Submit an extension request for existing delegated resources on TronSave via authenticated REST `POST /v2/extend-request`. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Side effect: creates an extension order and may commit TRX from the internal account. `extendData` must follow the REST contract (see schema on each row). Get `extendData` from `tronsave_internal_extend_delegates` (STEP 1) and pass the rows unchanged. Do not copy rows from `tronsave_list_extendable_delegates` (GraphQL); that payload shape differs and is for market discovery only.

extendData.description: Delegator-level rows for `POST /v2/extend-request`. Each row matches TronSave's REST extend contract (delegator, isExtend, extraAmount, extendTo in Unix seconds)—typically taken from `extendData` returned by `POST /v2/get-extendable-delegates` when called with the user's session, not from GraphQL `tronsave_list_extendable_delegates`.

extendTo.description: Target end time as Unix epoch SECONDS (UTC) for this delegator row in `POST /v2/extend-request`; echo the value returned by `tronsave_internal_extend_delegates`.

extraAmount.description: Additional resource amount to add (resource units).

isExtend.description: Whether to extend this delegation row.

receiver.description: TRON base58 address of the account that receives the delegated resource.

resourceType.description: Resource type. Default ENERGY when omitted.

name: tronsave_internal_create_extend_request
title: Submit Delegation Extension
